text:
hannah: FYI we just triaged a new signup where the README quickstart looked like it succeeded but then the embeddings call failed. Chat returned 200 but embeddings returned 401 with reason org.billing_consent_required. Customer confused.

hannah: Their curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":"hey"}'
```

miguel: That's the SSO-onboard race we've seen. Chat is routed to trial sandbox while embeddings hit the production gating checks. The SDK currently treats 401 as retryable which makes the sample app stall for ~5s and then surface a generic auth error.

sdk-bot: Related guidance: mark 4xx with body.reason starting with "org.billing_" as non-retriable and surface a BillingRequiredError containing a help_url when present.

hannah: Support workaround applied: owner accepted billing in console and customer unblocked. But we should fix quickstart DX so users don't hit this at all.

jess: Proposal: add a lightweight preflight call in the quickstart that hits /v1/onboarding/status and returns a compact object (billing_state, first_call_allowed, help_url). If billing_state != ready, show a one-line banner with help_url and skip the gated demo endpoints.

miguel: Also we'll update Node/Python SDKs to: 1) treat 401/402 with org.billing_* reasons as terminal, 2) include the API's help_url in the error object, and 3) expose a typed BillingRequiredError class so apps can handle it specially. I'll open PRs (node#5777, python#221).

support_bot: Filed ticket TKT-9001 for the customer and attached logs. Suggested short-term note for support: if chat works but embeddings fail, ask owner to check workspace billing consent/verification and provide console path.

hannah: Small docs ask: add a bullet under "first successful call" about workspace billing states and link to the console. Also add a note in quickstart README about the preflight.

miguel: ETA for SDK patches + quickstart change: ~48 hours. API UX follow-up: include help_url in all onboarding-related error responses so SDKs don't need heuristics. Opening INT-9001 to track API change.

jess: Thanks — customer was able to finish onboarding after owner accepted billing. Closing loop and leaving runbook note. :white_check_mark:
